title: "Jhimli is now a wife, a mother and a pocket-picker," Koushani Mukherjee reveals her most layered role yet in Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
description: Bohurupi The Golden Daku Movie: Following the phenomenal success of Bohurupi, one of Bengali cinema's most-loved characters is all set to make her return. Koushani Mukherjee reprises her role as Jhimli in Nandita Roy and Shiboprosad Mukherjee's much-awaited Bohurupi: The Golden Daku, arriving this Durga Puja 2026. (Koushani Mukherjee Jhimli Character) While audiences fell in love with the chemistry between Bikram and Jhimli in the first film, the sequel promises to take their relationship in an entirely new direction. Bigger in scale, richer in emotion and packed with unexpected twists, Bohurupi: The Golden Daku expands the world of its predecessor while giving Jhimli a far more layered and compelling journey. (Bohurupi Sequel Latest Update) Koushani Mukherjee Returns as Jhimli in 'Bohurupi: The Golden Daku', Promises a Bigger and Emotional Journey View this post on Instagram Sharing her excitement, Koushani Mukherjee said, "Jhimli is back on the big screen with Bohurupi: The Golden Daku, and I'm incredibly excited to step into her shoes once again. Audiences embraced Bikram and Jhimli's chemistry in Bohurupi, and this time, their journey returns with even more depth, emotion, romance and surprises. The scale of the film is much bigger, with extensive location shoots, making the entire experience grander than before. Jhimli herself has evolved in many ways, she's a wife, a mother, a pocket-picker, and a woman with multiple shades. I also get to portray her through five distinct looks, each reflecting a different phase of her journey. I truly believe audiences will discover a new side of Jhimli and connect with her all over again." Nandita Roy and Shiboprosad Mukherjee Reveal Jhimli’s Emotional Transformation in 'Bohurupi: The Golden Daku' Speaking about Jhimli's evolution, filmmakers Nandita Roy and Shiboprosad Mukherjee shared, "When we began writing Bohurupi: The Golden Daku, we knew Jhimli couldn't remain the same person audiences met in the first film. Life has changed her, her relationships have deepened and her choices carry greater emotional weight. Sohini has brought remarkable maturity and nuance to the character, making Jhimli's journey even more layered. We are excited for audiences to witness her transformation on the big screen this Puja." (Bohurupi The Golden Daku Durga Puja 2026) With a larger canvas, a thrilling dacoit story and beloved characters returning in unexpected ways, Bohurupi: The Golden Daku promises to be one of the biggest cinematic attractions of Durga Puja 2026. title: 'Lock Upp Season 2' Exclusive: Dheeraj Dhoopar Opens Up on Elimination, Controversies and His Reality Show Journey
description: Actor Dheeraj Dhoopar, who has always stayed away from reality shows, surprised everyone by participating in Lock Upp Season 2. Following his elimination, he spoke to the media about his journey, elimination, game strategy, relationships with fellow contestants, controversies inside the house, and the lessons he learned from the reality show. Here's what he had to say. Also read: Sony SAB’s Hastinapur Ke Veer: Jiten Lalwani on Dronacharya's Lesson for Arjun How was your journey on the show? Was it what you expected? For me, it was an incredible journey. I had never done a reality show before, nor had I watched many of them, so this was a completely new experience. The show taught me to appreciate the little things in life. Staying away from my family for so many days made me stronger as a person. Were you disappointed to be eliminated so early? I wouldn't call it disappointment because, after all, it's a game. I felt I was playing well. I was safe from the very first week and never reached Judgment Day. However, when previously eliminated contestants like Harshad Chopda and Yogesh returned as challengers, it was something I hadn't expected. Still, I accepted it as part of the game. People often said that the real Dheeraj Dhoopar wasn't visible on the show. What's your response? I was always surprised when people said that. From day one, I made it clear that I wasn't there to play the game—I was there to change it. I don't believe in creating unnecessary fights just for screen space or content. If someone had confronted me, I would have responded, but I couldn't create conflicts artificially. Throughout the show, I remained true to who I am. Also read: Dr. Khoja Vastu Consultant Expands Services Across Countries After Celebrity Reach Your argument with Ram Kapoor became one of the talking points. How do you look back at that incident? I have immense respect for my seniors, including Ram sir. The argument happened because I wanted my opinion to be heard. Fortunately, the very next day he came and hugged me. After that, he always respected my point of view, and I'm happy we moved on from that incident. Many questioned your decision to eliminate Yogesh Rawat. What would you like to say? It was my decision, and I had my own reasons behind it. Yogesh and I never shared a strong bond. When I had the power to save someone, it was entirely my choice. I don't think I owe anyone an explanation because it was a game, and I made the decision I felt was right. Your wife Vinny Arora was trolled on social media after your exit. How did you react? People should understand the difference between a game and real life. Dragging my wife into this was completely unfair. We were only playing a game inside the house, and it shouldn't affect our personal lives. Also read: Rekha Excellence in Cinema Award: Bollywood Icon Honoured for Legacy Has your friendship with Harshad and Shivangi Joshi changed? From the beginning, I knew they were each other's priority, and I respected that. Of course, I expected more support from some friends during difficult moments, but I don't hold any grudges. Everyone has the right to play their own game. I only believe that people should have their own opinions rather than changing their stand every day. What do you think about Shilpa Shinde's game? She understands reality shows extremely well. She knows exactly how to present herself in front of the camera and has played the game very smartly. She's a brilliant performer, and that clearly reflects in her gameplay. Also read: Pavala Shyamala Death News: Telugu Actress Dies at 75, Industry Mourns View this post on Instagram What was your biggest achievement during this journey? The biggest achievement for me was that people appreciated me for being my authentic self. I never picked unnecessary fights or used abusive language, yet the audience recognized and appreciated my genuine personality. That's my biggest victory. Will we see you in another reality show in the future? Honestly, I don't have any such plans right now. I've been offered several reality shows over the years, but I've always stayed away from them. This experience was good, but for now, I want to focus on my acting career.
